item.content:encoded:
World-Class Medical Treatment in India for International Patients

SPS Medcare is a Delhi NCR based medical tourism facilitator. We help patients and their families travel to India for affordable, world-class treatment at JCI and NABH accredited hospitals — and we handle everything around the treatment: the free second opinion, the medical visa letter, the airport pickup, the accommodation, the interpreter and a 24/7 care manager.

Our facilitation service is free for patients. Send your medical reports on WhatsApp to +91 99202 22362 and receive a written specialist opinion and an itemised cost estimate within 48 hours — at no charge and with no obligation.

Why Patients Choose India

  • Save 60–90% compared to treatment costs in the USA, UK and Europe
  • No waiting lists — most treatments begin within days of arrival
  • JCI & NABH accredited hospitals with internationally trained, English-speaking doctors
  • Outcomes at Western benchmarks in cardiac surgery, transplants, oncology and orthopedics
  • Easy medical visa for patient plus attendant, with e-visa options for many countries

Treatments We Coordinate

  • Cancer & Oncology Treatment — from $3,500 – $8,500 (vs $45,000 – $90,000 (USA))
  • Cardiac Surgery & Cardiology — from $4,200 – $7,000 (vs $60,000+ (USA))
  • Orthopedics & Joint Replacement — from $4,000 – $6,500 (vs $40,000+ (USA/UK))
  • Organ Transplants (Liver & Kidney) — from $12,000 – $28,000 (vs $150,000 – $300,000 (USA))
  • Neurosurgery & Spine Care — from $5,000 – $9,000 (vs $55,000+ (USA))
  • Bone Marrow Transplant (BMT) — from $15,000 – $25,000 (vs $180,000+ (USA))
  • Cosmetic & Plastic Surgery — from $1,800 – $4,500 (vs $12,000 – $25,000 (USA))
  • Urology & Nephrology — from $2,200 – $5,000 (vs $22,000+ (USA))
  • IVF & Fertility Treatment — from $2,500 – $4,200 (vs $18,000 – $30,000 (USA))
  • General & Laparoscopic Surgery — from $2,000 – $4,800 (vs $16,000 – $30,000 (USA))

Countries We Serve

We regularly assist patients travelling from Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka, United Arab Emirates, Nigeria, Afghanistan, Iraq, Maldives, Oman, Kenya, Yemen, Tanzania and beyond.

Talk to a Medical Coordinator

Call or WhatsApp +91 99202 22362, our Delhi office on 011 41000493, or email info@spsattestation.com. Our desk is open 24/7 for international patients across every time zone.

item.title: About Us
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
About SPS Medcare

SPS Medcare was founded in 2011 to solve a problem we watched families face again and again: excellent, affordable treatment existed in India, but reaching it from abroad meant navigating hospitals, visas, language, travel and accommodation entirely alone.

Since then we have guided more than 2,500 international patients from over 12 countries through treatment in Delhi NCR — from routine laparoscopic surgery to liver transplants and paediatric bone marrow transplants.

Our Promise

  • Zero facilitation fee — our service to patients is free; we never mark up hospital bills
  • Honest opinions — if travelling to India is not right for your case, we tell you
  • Accredited hospitals only — JCI and NABH accredited partners with published outcomes
  • One named coordinator from your first message until you land back home

Our Hospital Network

We work with Medanta – The Medicity, Fortis Memorial Research Institute, Apollo Hospitals, Max Super Speciality Hospitals, Fortis Escorts Heart Institute and the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre, among others across Delhi, Gurugram and Noida.

Contact

Call or WhatsApp +91 99202 22362, our office on 011 41000493, email info@spsattestation.com, or visit our patient desk at #123, 1st Floor, Vishal Tower, Janakpuri District Centre, Near Janakpuri West Metro, New Delhi - 110058, India.

item.title: Services
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Complete Support for Your Medical Journey

Treatment is only part of the journey. These six services cover everything else — and all of them are included free when you travel through SPS Medcare.

Medical Treatment Coordination

Free expert second opinions, written treatment plans and confirmed doctor appointments at JCI and NABH accredited hospitals including Fortis, Max, Medanta and Apollo.

Medical Visa Assistance

Official medical visa invitation letters issued within 24 hours for both patient and attendant, with step-by-step guidance for your Indian embassy application.

Airport Transportation

Complimentary airport pickup and drop at Delhi IGI in a patient-ready vehicle, plus all hospital transfers during your stay.

Accommodation Assistance

Hygienic guest houses, serviced apartments with kitchens, or 4/5-star hotels within minutes of your hospital, booked to your budget.

Language Interpreter Support

Dedicated interpreters fluent in Arabic, Bengali, Dari, Pashto, French, Russian and Swahili accompany you through consultations and admission.

24/7 WhatsApp Care Support

A named care manager on WhatsApp around the clock on +91 99202 22362 for medicine refills, follow-up appointments, currency exchange and local SIM cards.

Your Patient Journey, Step by Step

  • Share your reports: Send your diagnosis, scans and reports on WhatsApp. There is no charge and no obligation.
  • Get a free opinion & quote: Within 48 hours you receive a written opinion from a relevant specialist plus an itemised cost estimate.
  • Medical visa & travel: We issue your visa invitation letter within 24 hours and help you plan flights for patient and attendant.
  • Arrival & admission: We meet you at Delhi IGI, take you to your accommodation, and handle hospital admission paperwork.
  • Treatment & recovery: Your interpreter and care manager stay with you through treatment, discharge and recovery review.
  • Follow-up back home: You fly home with a complete discharge summary and medication plan, with teleconsultation follow-up.

item.title: Cancer & Oncology Treatment
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
India's leading cancer centres combine PET-CT and MRI-guided planning with CyberKnife and IMRT radiation, robotic surgical oncology, targeted therapy and immunotherapy — the same protocols followed in the US and Europe, at a fraction of the cost. SPS Medcare arranges your free expert second opinion, tumour board review, medical visa and complete stay so treatment can begin within days of your arrival rather than months on a waiting list.

Cost of Cancer & Oncology Treatment in India

  • Estimated cost in India: $3,500 – $8,500
  • Comparable cost abroad: $45,000 – $90,000 (USA)
  • You save: up to 85%
  • Hospital stay: 3 – 7 days
  • Total days in India: 14 – 21 days
  • Outcomes: Stage-dependent; 5-year survival on par with US centres

Procedures Covered

  • CyberKnife & IMRT precision radiotherapy
  • Robotic and open surgical oncology
  • Chemotherapy and targeted therapy cycles
  • Immunotherapy (checkpoint inhibitors)
  • PET-CT staging and tumour board review

Leading Hospitals for This Treatment

  • Apollo Cancer Centre, Delhi NCR
  • Fortis Memorial Research Institute, Gurugram
  • Medanta – The Medicity, Gurugram
  • Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket

item.title: Organ Transplants (Liver & Kidney)
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
India performs more living-donor liver transplants than almost any country, with graft survival rates above 90% at leading centres. Transplants for foreign nationals require a related donor and formal approval under India's NOTTO/THOA regulations — SPS Medcare guides you and your donor through every document, embassy attestation and hospital committee step, then coordinates the extended recovery stay and follow-up your case needs.

Cost of Organ Transplants (Liver & Kidney) in India

  • Estimated cost in India: $12,000 – $28,000
  • Comparable cost abroad: $150,000 – $300,000 (USA)
  • You save: up to 90%
  • Hospital stay: 10 – 14 days
  • Total days in India: 30 – 45 days
  • Outcomes: 90%+ one-year graft survival

Procedures Covered

  • Living-donor liver transplant (LDLT)
  • Living-donor kidney transplant
  • Paediatric liver transplant
  • ABO-incompatible and swap transplants
